column1: # Lamakan confrontation: Ash Jenna's origin, her offer, and Isaac's response.

column3: You found me again.\nI wasn't sure\nyou'd come back.{end_wait}
Back in the desert...\nWho are you, really?{end_wait}
You kept going.\nI suppose I owe you\nan answer.{end_wait}
You look like Jenna.\nBut you're not her.\nWho are you?{end_wait}

I'm Jenna. Not yours.
The Wise One stood by
as my world burned.{page_break}I watched it happen.
I survived.
That's why I'm here.{end_wait}
What do you want\nwith Isaac?{end_wait}

The beacons burned
in my world, too.{page_break}I believe the Wise One
let it happen.
Help me face him.{end_wait}
She may believe it.\nBut we can't tell\nif she's right.{end_wait}
Then we need proof.\nNot another fight\nwe don't understand.{end_wait}
You stayed with\nthose miners.\nYou could have left.{end_wait}
Take her offer?{end_now}
I'll help find out\nwhat happened.\nBut I need proof.{end_wait}
Then watch what\nhappens when the\nnext beacon burns.{end_wait}
Isaac, are you sure?\nWe barely know her.{end_wait}
Then don't look away.\nRemember what\nI told you.{end_wait}
No. I won't promise\nanything until\nwe know the truth.{end_wait}
Then find out\nfor yourself.\nI won't stop you.{end_wait}
We should go, Isaac.\nKalay is still ahead.{end_wait}
Her story may be true.\nBut we have to decide\nwhat to do ourselves.{end_wait}

Your Jenna and Kraden
are still with them.
Felix hasn't left.{page_break}Go on toward Kalay.
Don't let this
slow you down.{end_wait}
